summary: Iran's IRGC claims to have downed a U.S. MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island while conducting multiple missile and UAV tests across several provinces. Israeli forces struck Jabaliya in northern Gaza killing two Palestinians and conducted air operations in southern Lebanon. Six Gulf states formally demanded Iranian compensation for missile and UAV attack damages at the UN Security Council.
key_points: IRGC claims downing of U.S. MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island in southern Iran without U.S. confirmation (Source: @yediotnews25/137801)
Israeli drone strike in Jabaliya, northern Gaza kills two Palestinians; U.S. field hospital reports additional injuries (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10015)

Iran conducts multiple missile tests: ballistic missile from Isfahan, missile from Golestan, missile toward Strait of Hormuz, plus UAV launches from Omidiyeh AB and East Azerbaijan (Source: @shin_persian/12349, @shin_persian/12351, @shin_persian/12358, @shin_persian/12362, @shin_persian/12359)
Lebanese Army special operations raid Hezbollah weapons depot in Msharafieh, southern Beirut, seizing large weapons cache and arresting one suspect (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10020)
Six Gulf states demand Iranian compensation for missile and UAV attack damages since February 28 at UN Security Council (Source: @yediotnews25/137804)
Saudi Arabia intercepts two Houthi drones targeting Riyadh; Houthis claim 72 Saudi airstrikes in Yemen in 24 hours (Source: @yediotnews25/137799, @yediotnews25/137806)
Iraqi PM orders investigation into fuel smuggling in Jurf al-Sakhar, key IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah stronghold south of Baghdad (Source: @shin_persian/12364)

Israeli warplanes operate over southern Lebanon with artillery shelling in Wadi al-Hujeir and Wadi al-Saluqi, plus flare drops over multiple border towns (Source: @redlinkleb/53243, @redlinkleb/53239, @redlinkleb/53241, @redlinkleb/53220, @redlinkleb/53214, @redlinkleb/53221)

points: IRGC claims downing of U.S. MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island in southern Iran; no U.S. confirmation provided. The incident occurred amid heightened Iranian air defense activity across multiple provinces. (Source: @yediotnews25/137801)
Air defense activity reported on Marand-Tabriz road in East Azerbaijan Province at 20:29 local time (1659Z), indicating heightened alert status in northwestern Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12360)
Ballistic missile test launched from Isfahan Province at 1006Z (13:36 Tehran time) from a known missile development center. (Source: @shin_persian/12349)

Missile test launch from Golestan Province at 13:38 local (1008Z) and separate missile launch toward Strait of Hormuz from Hormozgan Province at 20:17 local (1647Z). (Source: @shin_persian/12351, @shin_persian/12358)
UAV launch from Omidiyeh Air Base in Khuzestan Province and UAV activity over Jolfa and Hadishahr in East Azerbaijan at 20:23 local (1653Z). (Source: @shin_persian/12362, @shin_persian/12359)
Iranian navy reports oil tanker caught fire after hitting naval mine in Strait of Hormuz, adding maritime dimension to regional tensions. (Source: @yediotnews25/137799)

Six Gulf states (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman) formally demand Iranian compensation for missile and UAV attack damages on their territories since February 28, presented at UN Security Council by GCC Secretary General Jassim Al-Budaiwi. (Source: @yediotnews25/137804)

Israeli drone strike in Jabaliya, northern Gaza kills two Palestinians according to Shifa Hospital officials; U.S. field hospital near the area reports additional injuries. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10015)
Two Hamas militants, including a platoon commander, attacked in Jabaliya at midday per weekend security summary. (Source: @yediotnews25/137799)
Israeli warplanes observed over southern Lebanon with air strike reported on Aita al-Jabal. (Source: @redlinkleb/53243, @redlinkleb/53245)
Four minors arrested for stone-throwing at bus in Har Homa, Jerusalem, damaging rear window; incident reflects ongoing West Bank tensions. (Source: @N12chat/235050)
Rescue operation on Road 505 in Samaria: three trapped extracted from vehicle down 500-meter slope, evacuated by Unit 669 helicopter after complex rope rescue. (Source: @yediotnews25/137807)
